stem: At what duration of continuous seizure activity do clinicians typically begin active medical treatment for status epilepticus?
explanation: Clinical practice dictates starting treatment at 5 minutes to prevent the seizure from becoming refractory, even though the formal definition was historically 30 minutes.
rationale: Differentiate between the 'traditional' definition and the 'operational' clinical threshold for intervention.

optionExplanations.A: Most brief seizures resolve spontaneously within 1-2 minutes, so treatment usually waits until the 5-minute mark.
optionExplanations.B: Clinical practice dictates starting treatment at 5 minutes to prevent the seizure from becoming refractory, even though the formal definition was historically 30 minutes.
optionExplanations.C: Waiting 15 minutes increases the risk of the seizure becoming harder to control and causing neurological damage.
optionExplanations.D: While 30 minutes is the traditional definition of status, treatment starts much earlier to avoid the high risks associated with prolonged activity.
